bayts.text: O God! By the Chosen One (Al-Muṣṭafā), the Noble and Valiant, O God! And by Your intimate friend Abraham (Ibrāhīm), O God!
And by Your interlocutor Moses (Mūsā), Ṣāliḥ, Khiḍr, and by Shuʿayb and Ishmael (Ismāʿīl), O God!
And by Solomon (Sulaymān), Noah (Nūḥ), Jonah (Yūnus), Elisha (Al-Yasaʿ), and Zechariah, John (Yaḥyā), Hūd, O God!
Aaron (Hārūn), Joshua (Yūshaʿ), Elijah (Ilyās), Adam, David (Dāwūd), Dhū l-Kifl, Jesus (ʿĪsā), Lot (Lūṭ), O God!
And by Joseph (Yūsuf) and by Isaac (Isḥāq) and by the other prophets and messengers who are Yours, O God!
And by the Angels, all of them, and then their elect, Gabriel (Jibrīl), then Michael (Mīkāʾīl), O God!
And by the Master of the Blowing, Isrāfīl, the seizer of the spirits of creatures, ʿAzrāʾīl, O God!
And by the Companions, then the Friends of God together, and the learned who act upon their knowledge, O God!
And by the Truthful (Aṣ-Ṣiddīq), and by the Distinguisher (Al-Fārūq), then by the Possessor of the Two Lights, then by the father of the Two Grandsons, O God!
By Mālik, possessor of excellences, Ash-Shāfiʿī, Abū Ḥanīfa, Aḥmad the Praised, O God!
By the Tablet and the Preserved Pen, then by Your Immense Throne and by the Footstool, O God!
By the Qurʾān and by the Torah, then by what David brought, and the Spirit, O God!
Convey my blessing and my greeting of peace upon him, and upon his Family, Companions and wives, O God!
And let fall upon us, O Lord, well-being, and grant us moderation in the two abodes, O God!
And open for us every door that You have opened of good things for the righteous, O God!
And lead us on the path of right guidance, and spare us from slipping, and drive away from us the jinn and Satan, O God!
And perfect all that we aim at and intend, and grant us all that we choose, O God!
And tame for us everything hard and stubborn, and make easy everything difficult, O God!
Lengthen our life, make our body sound, and grant us right guidance and success, O God!
And destroy every enemy who would harm us, before they reach us, O God, O God!
And be for us a protector from every place of destruction, and save us from the affliction of time, O God!
And from calamity, plague, and choking grief, trials, earthquake, hardship, and poverty, O God!
From humiliation, scarcity, abasement, defeat, destitution, thirst, and hunger, O God!
And from tribulation, pestilence, burning, together with drowning, lightning, together with theft, and toil, O God!
From heat and cold, plunder, distress, vengeances, error, lameness, and sorrow, O God!
And from the venomous and harmful creature, and from transgression and fault, from straying and ruinous loss, from slips, and transformation, and engulfment, and then from slander, O God!
And from burning thirst and inner anguish, together with madness, ailment, disease, then the two leprosies, and diminishment, O God!
And from the ugliness of this world and then the Hereafter, and from the disgrace of both, O God, O God!
O You who are Able over all things, and who rose over the Immense Throne with dominion, O God!
Truly I ask You for a heart humbled and lowly, and for knowledge of great benefit, O God!
And a repentance accepted, together with a station raised, together with a wife made righteous by religion, O God!
And be our protector from the evil of the envier, together with the evil of the mouth and the evil of the eye, O God!
And from the evil of sorcery, and the evil of creatures, their humankind together with their jinn, and the venomous, O God!
Truly I have made You, in the two abodes, O my Trust, a fortified stronghold; so be my refuge, O God!
So do not entrust me to myself, lest I perish; be the One who answers me wherever I call upon You, O God!
And make my tongue and my heart both remember You at death, together with faith, O God!
Make firm my certainty in my heart without fear, until I love meeting You, the Truth, O God!
And make for me death a rest and a joy from every evil and every distress that has narrowed, O God!
And preserve for me the body when the spirit has parted from me; in the grave let it never decay through time, O God!
And be a helper and companion to me when they bury my body and I become alone there, O God!
Do not join with me what may frighten me, but rather suffice me against all that I fear, O God!
And save me and all the Muslims together, and save my mother, Amen, O God!
And forgive us and her, and conceal our faults, and be gentle with us and with her in the terror, O God!
Pass over her faults and have mercy on us, for we have none but You, and You are the Most Kind, O God!
In the Barzakh and in the grave be a refuge for her, and from distresses and fear save her, O God!
Do not test her with what she is not able to bear, and do not disappoint her hope in You, O God!
And give us to drink, together with her, from the water of the Kawthar of him whom You chose out of all creation, O God!
He (the one You chose) who guided the one lost in error, destroyed the unbeliever, and gave victory to him who fears You, O God!
Muḥammad, the radiant one among the best, our leader to the Garden of Eternity on the Day of Gathering, O God!
Bless him and grant him peace always, forever, and those who follow him, until the Day of Judgement, O God!
